en.hubeali: From him, form one of his companions, raising it, said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The white rooster is my<sup>asws</sup> friend and a friend of every Believer’.
en.sarwar: It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from certain persons of his people in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘The white rooster is my friend and the friend of every believing person.’”
